Anatomy of a GET Request

https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=35.28&longitude=-120.66&current=temperature_2m
Protocol
https://
Base URL
api.open-meteo.com
Endpoint
/v1/forecast
Query Parameters
?latitude=35.28&longitude=-120.66&current=temperature_2m
The address (protocol + base URL + endpoint) says where to ask; the query parameters say what you want back. The protocol and base URL rarely change — keep your eye on the endpoint and the query.
